data.title: File
data.tagline: A UI row or card that shows one document, image, or attachment and its status
data.description: An upload list might show `project-plan.pdf`, 2.4 MB, and Uploaded. Make the filename most prominent and use type and status as support; an icon alone does not identify the file.

distinctions.label: Upload
distinctions.explanation: File displays a file that exists or is being processed. Upload covers the full flow of choosing, transferring, and processing a file.

avoid: An icon with no readable filename
A hidden status or delete action

lessonPractice.title: A user selected three attachments: one is uploading, one failed, and one completed. What should the upload area show next?

options.label: Show each file's name, size, state, and the relevant retry or remove action
options.feedback: File items let users confirm each object and its result, while actions target the correct attachment.

options.label: Hide file details and show only a paperclip with 3 files selected
options.feedback: A total count cannot identify the failed or active file, and users cannot verify what they selected.

options.label: Keep only the Choose files button and list attachments after every upload finishes
options.feedback: Without per-file progress, users cannot notice failure, remove a mistaken file, or know whether to wait.

data.agentPrompt: Create file items immediately after selection with readable names, sizes, upload states, and per-file actions. Failed items can retry, active ones can cancel, and completed ones can be removed. Test duplicate names, long names, and failed uploads.
